with-redis.queue-failover: Queue on Node is the local file provider. Jobs that A accepted wait in A's directory after A stops.
with-redis.rate-limit-shared: Rate Limit on Node is forced to the memory driver. Each instance allows 10 per minute.
with-redis.realtime-fanout: Realtime on Node has only the memory authority. Rooms do not fan out across instances.
with-redis.schedule-once: The Schedule process driver locks in memory with fs-lite KV. Each instance runs every occurrence.
with-redis.migrations-once: Postgres migrations do not run on start. Only `vitehub db migrate` applies them.
with-redis.kv-shared: KV on Node defaults to fs-lite in each working directory. No Redis or Database driver exists.
with-redis.workflow-shared: OpenWorkflow workers race on their schema setup at cold start. Usually only one or two of three start.
